This document outlines the equipment checklist I1, to 
be performed 
on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block 
The first draft initiated by eng 
Emad Farouk Mostafa at 
Kattamia
substation 220kv and tested at first of June 02

Note: 
HB: SF6 circuit breaker for installation indoor

The circuit breaker type 
HB can equipped with:

- 
Closing coil: provided the spring storage mechanism is still sufficiently 
charged

- 
Shunt trip coil: for operating an "open" element,

- 
Rewind motor 220v ac: for charging the spring storage mechanism.

items: A work permit must be issued,

The qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution 
marks surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc
The circuit breaker should be switched off.
The HV & LV terminals must be correctly disconnected and grounded.
The spring of operating mechanism must be blocked.

Set of mechanicals tools, torque wrenches 
 with hex, SF6 gas
Check the operating pressure.
Check the tightening of the equipment.
Check the settings of the valves and relays.
Check the degree of pollution of insulating medium.

In order to prevent the damage to CB neither operating mechanism nor the 
 contacts should be manipulated while the spring assembly is fully or only 
 partially charged
Ensure that the system is left in open position.

Check the status of SF6 (not flammable, non toxic, odorless, colorless, stable 
 chemically and is inert up to approximately 50 oC )

Check the gas pressure by looking at the manometer if it is diving the green 
 and red zones further SF6 must be added.

Never operate the CB without an adequate amount of gas in the gas compartment, 
 as otherwise the pneumatic damping system will not operate and the CB may 
 suffer mechanical damage as a result
Screw the valve cap of the gas filling valve by hand.
Open the gate valve of the cylinder,

Flush the hose connection between the gas tank, the pressure reduction valve, 
 and the lever plug connection to the gas filling valve.

Set the pressure reduction valve so that the secondary pressure reduction 
 corresponding to the rated filling pressure at gas temperature of 20 oC 
 is 6 bar (5) over pressure

Regularly check the gas pressure on manometer 11, indicator needle should be 
 near the upper limit in the green zone.

Screw the valve cap back to the gas filling valve 10 by hand, ensuring a tight 
 fit

text:
Substations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment checklist I1, to 
be performed 
on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block 
The first draft initiated by eng 
Emad Farouk Mostafa at 
Kattamia
substation 220kv and tested at first of June 02
Note: 
HB: SF6 circuit breaker for installation indoor
24 : Rated voltage in kv
06 : Rated current corresponding ti 630A
25 : Rated braking current in KA
The circuit breaker type 
HB can equipped with:
- 
Closing coil: provided the spring storage mechanism is still sufficiently 
charged
- 
Shunt trip coil: for operating an "open" element,
- 
Electrical pressure monitor,
- 
Operating counter,
- 
Rewind motor 220v ac: for charging the spring storage mechanism.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued,
The qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution 
marks surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc
The circuit breaker should be switched off.
The HV & LV terminals must be correctly disconnected and grounded.
The spring of operating mechanism must be blocked.
Tools and Equipment
Set of mechanicals tools, torque wrenches 
 with hex, SF6 gas
Work to be Carried Out
Check the operating pressure.
Check the tightening of the equipment.
Check the settings of the valves and relays.
Check the degree of pollution of insulating medium.
In order to prevent the damage to CB neither operating mechanism nor the 
 contacts should be manipulated while the spring assembly is fully or only 
 partially charged
Ensure that the system is left in open position.
Handling the quenching Medium 
Figure 4
Check the status of SF6 (not flammable, non toxic, odorless, colorless, stable 
 chemically and is inert up to approximately 50 oC )
Check the gas pressure by looking at the manometer if it is diving the green 
 and red zones further SF6 must be added.
Never operate the CB without an adequate amount of gas in the gas compartment, 
 as otherwise the pneumatic damping system will not operate and the CB may 
 suffer mechanical damage as a result
Filling the SF6 Gas 
Figure 4
Screw the valve cap of the gas filling valve by hand.
Open the gate valve of the cylinder,
Flush the hose connection between the gas tank, the pressure reduction valve, 
 and the lever plug connection to the gas filling valve.
Set the pressure reduction valve so that the secondary pressure reduction 
 corresponding to the rated filling pressure at gas temperature of 20 oC 
 is 6 bar (5) over pressure
Regularly check the gas pressure on manometer 11, indicator needle should be 
 near the upper limit in the green zone.
Screw the valve cap back to the gas filling valve 10 by hand, ensuring a tight 
 fit
